title: Geohydrologic framework of the Coastal Plain aquifers of South Carolina
citation: Aucott, W.R., Davis, M.E., and Speiran, G.K., 1987, Geohydrologic framework of the Coastal Plain aquifers of South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 85-4271, map scale 1:1,000,000.
notes: USGS WRIR 85-4271 (Aucott, Davis and Speiran, 1987), geohydrologic framework of the South Carolina Coastal Plain aquifers: 7 plates (text, sections A-A' to H-H', structure-contour maps of aquifer tops/bases). Wells recorded from the well-data tables of the sections (label, name, county, printed latitude/longitude, altitude above sea level, total depth); rows whose numbers are garbled by OCR keep only the legible fields, and wells listed on several sections are recorded once (first legible row); HO-348 total depth (OCR '17' and 'N7') left out; wells whose rows are too garbled to parse (e.g. DOR-211, AK-266, AL-22, BFT-454, BFT-457, WIL-33, SU-146, FLO-149, MRN-68, BAM-27, BAM-28, CLA-25, BRK-26) are not recorded. Sections recorded with their well lists only; aquifer and confining-unit boundaries on the sections and contour values on the maps are not digitized (re-read with images queued). Plate 1 text describes the aquifers but its OCR is multi-column and garbled in part. SUBSURFACE: section contacts and contour lines not digitized.
